fixed_failure: Green creep already on the floor remained harmful after permanent Charm. Conversion now disables player harm for owned creep. A separate early regression run used an old monster-test executable while its target was rebuilding; final six-suite run follows terminal build completion.
adaptations: HP/size and broad modifier roles use pinned wiki; movement multipliers and creep/blast strengths are authored DeathWard tuning, not exact native champion-engine recovery.
Supported champion pool uses uniform selection; it does not reproduce all original champion rarity weights.
Death effects occur on final death after any same-entity headless morph.
Existing ordinary loot remains: champion-specific hearts, batteries, pills and other pickups are unimplemented.
Four captures were run concurrently; their displayed FPS is not a controlled performance measurement.
